parts:
---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: ben.c...@lehman.com <benjami...@lehman.com>
Date: Mon, Nov 30, 2009 at 1:46 PM
Subject: problem installing RHIPE package into R
To: sg...@purdue.edu


Hi Saptarshi,

We are very interested in exploring the potential of using RHIPE to
help us bridge our R-based Risk Analytics platform to interface with
new exttremely large (13+ TB)  Hadoop-based data sources.    We have
downloaded the RHIPE_0.51.tar.gz bundled, confirmed all the
pre-requisites as documented at the RHIPE web site, but encounter the
attached error when we execute

R CMD INSTALL Rhipe_0.51.tar.gz

Are we doing anything wrong?    Also, is there any RHIPE user mailing
list and/or user support forum that you could point us to?  Would you
be available/willing to assist us installing RHIPE in our R/Hadoop
environemnt?

many thanks for any consideration to help, we would like to take a
strong look at RHIPE and are excited about its potential,

Ben

messages.author: 59eed29998a3863e
messages.subject: Re: problem installing RHIPE package into R (ben cotton)
parts:
Our data is still 99% warehoused in a variety of legacy RDBMS systems
(DB2, Oracle, SQL Server). We have just recently gotten our Hadoop
cluster prototype up and running, and we are using the Cloudera
'sqoop' tool to migrate very small subsets of that data to HDFS.

We are still in a "proof of concept" stage re: R/Hadoop (via RHIPE)
and so we have not yet made a significant data migration to HDFS.
